A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same LoPE study. All 23 pages of each version, including Appendices A-D and the checklist, support comparison of the text, equations, figures and tables.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations and ablations in Sections 4-5, with additional task-level results in Appendix D.

after.justification: v4 retains the original LoPE benchmark evaluations, ablations and Appendix D task-level results.

M1.justification: Both versions retain the same asymmetric LoRA architecture, HyNoIse injection, two-stage fine-tuning, DyCompEnSate mechanism and inference-time poisoning-expert masking.

E1.justification: Both use Alpaca-52K for fine-tuning and evaluate on MMLU, its selected domain groups, GSM8K, PIQA, SIQA and ARC-e. The original and noise-injected data scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: The evaluated comparators remain P-Tuning, Prefix Tuning, AdaLoRA, LoRA and HydraLoRA. Comparator membership also matches in the backbone comparisons and Appendix D.

E3.justification: Both retain the 10% Alpaca fine-tuning sample, accuracy metric, stated noise ratios, backbone models, rank/expert configurations and training settings. No evaluation protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: Sections 4.4-5 retain the same analyses of noise types, backbone choice, compensation, injection intensity, expert counts and masking. Their tested questions and supporting evidence are unchanged.

E5.justification: Table 1 retains the same uncertainty reporting, and Appendix B.2 retains random seed 614. Neither version adds run counts, uncertainty definitions or statistical testing procedures relative to the other.

E6.justification: Reported values and findings match across Tables 1-4, Appendix D Tables 6-11, and Figures 3-4. No result entries, rankings or plotted trends are added, removed or corrected.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and forward-computation expressions, including Equations 1-4 and the expert-similarity definition, retain the same content. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about obtaining noise robustness through generated noise, asymmetric poisoning experts and selective masking without data cleaning.

C2.justification: Interpretations of expert dependencies and excessive noise remain unchanged. Appendix C retains the same limitations concerning dependence on LoRA and not explicitly considering the noisy-data distribution.

D1.justification: Section 4.2 and Appendix B retain the same implementation disclosures, including learning rate 0.0002, one epoch, H800 hardware and software versions. Code/data access disclosures are unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning relative to denoising methods, MoE-LoRA and HydraLoRA are unchanged. Reference differences are typographical.

P1.justification: v4 expands the abbreviated affiliation, adds Wenhong Tian's correspondence information, replaces the placeholder author footnote and changes the conference footer to 'Preprint. Under review.' Scientific prose and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded author block produces minor reflow across the opening pages, with small typesetting differences elsewhere. Figures 1-4 and Tables 1-11 retain their content and display structure.

improvement.justification: v4 cleans up first-page affiliation, correspondence and publication-status information, but retains the same methods, evidence, explanations, limitations and reproducibility details throughout the paper and appendices. These limited administrative and typesetting edits do not meaningfully change overall paper quality.
